name: Allies
description: Aides and friends who help you in tasks — close, capable companions; each Ally is a Storyteller character.

name: Artifact
description: Wondrous devices of the First Age that you own, rated by power and rarity. (Dragon-Blooded receive twice the dots' worth of artifacts.)

name: Backing
description: Standing and rank within an organization of power, such as the Realm, a Guild, or a society.

name: Contacts
description: Information sources and useful connections in various places.

name: Familiar
description: An animal companion bonded to you and sustained by your Essence, rated by capability.

name: Followers
description: Mortals who look to you for leadership, rated by their number and devotion.

name: Influence
description: Your pull and status in society — political, social, or commercial.

name: Manse
description: A geomantic structure over a demesne that produces Essence and houses a Hearthstone.

name: Mentor
description: A patron, teacher, or defender who advises and aids you, rated by their power.

name: Resources
description: Your material wealth and income, from destitute to fabulously wealthy.

name: Breeding
description: The purity of your Terrestrial bloodline: higher Breeding means more pronounced elemental markings, a stronger anima banner, and larger Essence pools.

name: Connections
description: Ties into one area of the Realm's web of institutions and cliques (chosen per instance, e.g. a House or the legions); serves as both Contacts and Influence for the Dragon-Blooded.

name: Command
description: The earned right to command soldiers of the legions or a House army, from a single fang (5) up to an entire dragon (500) fighting under your banner.

name: Henchmen
description: UnExalted characters of note who have sworn personal oaths of loyalty to you, rated by their number.

name: Reputation
description: How widely your exploits are known across the Dynasty and the Realm; may be added to Social rolls where fame carries weight (or subtracted where it is a liability).
